turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been having this cough for around, I would say half a year now and I just can't seem to get rid of it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And does this cough have any phlegm that you bring up?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and since the cough started, has it been getting getting worse, staying the same, getting any better?

turns.text: It was pretty much the same for I would say like three or four months, but then I've noticed it getting more frequent over the last couple of months.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and six months ago, can you think of anything that that changed? Including like, traveling anywhere or changing in in your work or or living environment?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not really, uh, I'm like almost 75 years old now, so I just thought it was probably just due to my age.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uh, have you been have you brought up any blood with the cough?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um, and has there been anything that's made the cough worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes when, I'm exercising a lot more but not not too much, it's kind of just always been there, hasn't really changed too much, but it's gotten more frequent over the last couple of months.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and anything that's made the cough better that you've tried?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is the cough worse in the morning, throughout the day or or at night?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um and, you mentioned some joint pains as well and then when did that those start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say over the last year is when I started noticing it a lot more than before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been having joint stiffness or or muscle stiffness early in the morning?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any red hot or or kind of swollen joints?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of, nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um, and how has your energy been? Have you been experiencing a lot of fatigue?

turns.text: Yeah, I definitely have been more tired. I can't really even go outside for a walk sometimes or I get really tired working in the garden. So it's been tough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when did that when did you notice that change and and how were you different before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Like before, like before six months ago, I remember I used to be able to go for long walks around the block, then when I was gardening I can go on for hours, but now I'm pretty it's pretty limited to like maybe 15-20 minutes and then I have to go back into the house.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see OK, so pretty big difference over the last six months to a year for you.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Patient
